raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly assumed that the Scikit-Learn July 2017 changelog would be located under version 0.19. In reality, Scikit-Learn version 0.18 was released in June 2017 and version 0.19 was released in August 2017. Therefore, the "July 2017" updates correspond to version 0.18, not 0.19. This fundamental error in identifying the correct version led the WebSurfer to search for the wrong changelog repeatedly, preventing the discovery of the correct answer (BaseLabelPropagation).
